# <zbk-menu>

An anchored action menu. One real button owns the invoker relationship;
opening moves focus into a roving list of native command buttons. Native
popover promotion supplies the top layer where available, while shared
anchored positioning owns flip, shift, and viewport tracking.

Base class: `.zbk-menu`. Variant classes: `.zbk-menu--{variant}`. Tokens: `--zbk-menu-{property}[-{state}]`. Write `aria-*`/`role` on the element; they relocate to the internal native element. `focus()` forwards to the internal focusable.

## When to use

- A compact button reveals a list of immediate actions.
- Commands need arrow-key traversal and typeahead in a transient anchored panel.
- NOT The choices set a form value. → zbk-select
- NOT Items navigate to destinations. → zbk-link in a plain navigation list
- NOT The overlay contains arbitrary interactive controls or rich content. → zbk-popover

## Guidance

- Use one real button or zbk-button in the trigger slot; the component wires the invoker and ARIA relationship.
- Default children are only zbk-menu-item commands and hr separators.
- Use placement as a preference: the panel flips and shifts to stay in the viewport.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the command panel is open. |
| `placement` | `Placement` | `"bottom-start"` | Preferred floating-ui placement; flip and shift preserve viewport fit. |
| `variant` | `string` | `""` | Space-separated registered variant names, e.g. "ghost lg". Unknown names warn with the registered vocabulary. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| *(default)* | Action commands expressed as zbk-menu-item elements, optionally separated by hr elements. | — |
| `trigger` | The single real button, or component wrapping one, that opens the action menu. | required |

- `trigger`: Use native button semantics; a role=button span does not provide the invoker contract.

## Keyboard

- `Enter / Space / ArrowDown` — Opens from the trigger and focuses the first command.
- `ArrowUp on trigger` — Opens and focuses the last command.
- `ArrowDown / ArrowUp` — Moves command focus with wrapping.
- `Home / End` — Moves focus to the first or last command.
- `Printable characters` — Moves focus to the next command whose label starts with the accumulated 500ms typeahead buffer.
- `Escape` — Closes and returns focus to the trigger.
- `Tab` — Closes and continues normal document focus order.

## Events

No custom events. Native events (`click`, `change`, `input`, ...) bubble from the internal native element in light DOM — listen on the zebkit element.

## Examples

**Actions**

```html
<zbk-menu><zbk-button slot="trigger">Actions</zbk-button><zbk-menu-item>Rename</zbk-menu-item><zbk-menu-item>Duplicate</zbk-menu-item><hr><zbk-menu-item variant="critical">Delete</zbk-menu-item></zbk-menu>
```

The commands act on the current object and receive the complete menu-button keyboard contract.

**Unavailable command**

```html
<zbk-menu placement="bottom-end"><zbk-button slot="trigger">More</zbk-button><zbk-menu-item>Archive</zbk-menu-item><zbk-menu-item disabled>Restore</zbk-menu-item></zbk-menu>
```

The unavailable command remains discoverable in arrow-key traversal but blocks activation.

## Tokens (CSS custom properties)

Values are alias references (`{family.name}` compiles to `var(--zbk-family-name)`) or structural literals. Override any of them on a selector to re-style; nothing else is needed.

| Token | Default | Type | Condition | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--zbk-menu-canvas` | `{app.canvas}` | color | — | Menu panel background. |
| `--zbk-menu-border-color` | `{app.border}` | color | — | Menu panel border color. |
| `--zbk-menu-border-width` | `{border.width-sm}` | dimension | — | Menu panel border width. |
| `--zbk-menu-border-style` | `{border.style}` | strokeStyle | — | Menu panel border style. |
| `--zbk-menu-border-radius` | `{border.radius-md}` | dimension | — | Menu panel corner radius. |
| `--zbk-menu-padding-inline` | `{spacing.2xs}` | dimension | — | Inline padding inside the command panel. |
| `--zbk-menu-padding-block` | `{spacing.2xs}` | dimension | — | Block padding inside the command panel. |
| `--zbk-menu-min-width` | `12rem` | dimension | — | Minimum command panel width. |
| `--zbk-menu-max-height` | `40vh` | cssDimension | — | Maximum command panel height before scrolling. |
| `--zbk-menu-offset` | `{spacing.2xs}` | dimension | — | Gap between the trigger and command panel. |
| `--zbk-menu-box-shadow` | `{elevation.md}` | shadow | — | Menu panel shadow. |
| `--zbk-menu-z-index` | `{z-index.dropdown}` | number | — | Stacking order when native top-layer promotion is unavailable. |
| `--zbk-menu-separator-color` | `{app.border}` | color | — | Separator rule color. |
| `--zbk-menu-separator-width` | `{border.width-sm}` | dimension | — | Separator rule width. |
| `--zbk-menu-separator-margin-block` | `{spacing.2xs}` | dimension | — | Block margin around separators. |
| `--zbk-menu-opacity` | `1` | number | — | Panel opacity — the property the transition below interpolates. |
| `--zbk-menu-transition-duration` | `{transition.calm-fx-duration-default}` | duration | — | Menu panel effect transition duration. **(a11y)** |
| `--zbk-menu-transition-timing-function` | `{transition.calm-fx-function-default}` | cubicBezier | — | Menu panel effect transition timing function. |

## Variants

No shipped variants.

Custom variants: add a `zbk-menu.variants.json` file to the base theme's token folder (component-keyed map of `{ "menu": { "{name}": { "overrides": { ... } } } }`; token keys must exist in the table above, values are alias references or structural literals). A shipped variant name patches that variant's CSS — usable immediately. A new name compiles a new `.zbk-menu--{name}` class and additionally needs `ZebkitElement.registerVariants(json)` before elements upgrade so `variant="{name}"` validates and applies it.

Related: `<zbk-menu-item>`, `<zbk-button>`, `<zbk-popover>`, `<zbk-select>`, `<zbk-link>`.
